items.question: Trong câu "A singly linked list is a sequence of nodes.", từ "sequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A singly linked list is a sequence of nodes.", what does "sequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sequence /ˈsiːkwəns/ (danh từ): dãy nối tiếp. "A sequence of X" = một dãy X nối tiếp nhau theo thứ tự; từ này rất hay gặp khi mô tả list và string.
items.explanationEn: sequence /ˈsiːkwəns/ (noun): an ordered series of items. "A sequence of X" is a series of X in a fixed order; it is common when describing lists and strings.

items.question: Trong câu "Each node stores a value and a pointer (next) to the following node; the last node points to null.", từ "pointer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each node stores a value and a pointer (next) to the following node; the last node points to null.", what does "pointer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pointer /ˈpɔɪntə(r)/ (danh từ): con trỏ (tham chiếu). Trong lập trình, pointer là thứ "chỉ tới" một đối tượng khác; đời thường nó còn có nghĩa là lời khuyên (a useful pointer).
items.explanationEn: pointer /ˈpɔɪntə(r)/ (noun): a reference to another object. In programming a pointer refers to another object; in everyday English "a pointer" can also mean a useful tip.

items.question: Trong câu ""Singly" means each node knows only its successor — you can walk forward, never backward (the doubly linked list in the next topic adds a prev pointer).", từ "successor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Singly" means each node knows only its successor — you can walk forward, never backward (the doubly linked list in the next topic adds a prev pointer).", what does "successor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: successor /səkˈsesə(r)/ (danh từ): phần tử đứng sau. Successor (đứng sau) là từ trái nghĩa của predecessor (đứng trước); nghĩa "người kế nhiệm" dùng cho người.
items.explanationEn: successor /səkˈsesə(r)/ (noun): the item that comes next. Successor (what follows) is the opposite of predecessor (what comes before); for people it means someone who takes over a role.

items.question: Trong câu "An array is one contiguous block of memory, so arr[i] is a single address calculation.", từ "contiguous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An array is one contiguous block of memory, so arr[i] is a single address calculation.", what does "contiguous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: contiguous /kənˈtɪɡjuəs/ (tính từ): liền kề, liên tục. "Contiguous memory" = vùng nhớ liền một khối; đây là lý do array truy cập theo index nhanh.
items.explanationEn: contiguous /kənˈtɪɡjuəs/ (adjective): next to each other, unbroken. "Contiguous memory" is one unbroken block; it is why arrays have fast index access.

items.question: Trong câu "An array is one contiguous block of memory, so arr[i] is a single address calculation.", từ "calculation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An array is one contiguous block of memory, so arr[i] is a single address calculation.", what does "calculation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: calculation /ˌkælkjuˈleɪʃn/ (danh từ): phép tính toán. "A simple calculation" = một phép tính đơn giản; động từ là calculate.
items.explanationEn: calculation /ˌkælkjuˈleɪʃn/ (noun): a mathematical computation. "A simple calculation" is an easy computation; the verb is calculate.

items.question: Trong câu "Linked list nodes are separate objects scattered around the heap, glued together only by references.", từ "scattered" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linked list nodes are separate objects scattered around the heap, glued together only by references.", what does "scattered" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: scattered /ˈskætəd/ (tính từ): rải rác khắp nơi. "Scattered around X" = nằm rải rác quanh X; trái nghĩa với contiguous.
items.explanationEn: scattered /ˈskætəd/ (adjective): spread over a wide area. "Scattered around X" means spread all over X; it is the opposite of contiguous.

items.question: Trong câu "Linked list nodes are separate objects scattered around the heap, glued together only by references.", từ "glue" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linked list nodes are separate objects scattered around the heap, glued together only by references.", what does "glue" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: glue /ɡluː/ (động từ): gắn kết, dán lại. "Glued together by X" = được gắn kết với nhau nhờ X; nghĩa đen là dán bằng keo.
items.explanationEn: glue /ɡluː/ (verb): to stick things together. "Glued together by X" means held together by X; literally it means to stick with glue.

items.question: Trong câu "Linked list nodes are separate objects scattered around the heap, glued together only by references.", từ "reference" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linked list nodes are separate objects scattered around the heap, glued together only by references.", what does "reference" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a book for looking things up
a link to an object in memory
items.explanation: reference /ˈrefrəns/ (danh từ): tham chiếu (tới đối tượng). Trong JavaScript, object được truyền bằng reference; "a reference to X" = tham chiếu tới X.
items.explanationEn: reference /ˈrefrəns/ (noun): a link to an object in memory. In JavaScript objects are passed by reference; "a reference to X" is a link to X.

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: pick a linked list when you add and remove at the front a lot and rarely need random access.", từ "rule of thumb" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule of thumb: pick a linked list when you add and remove at the front a lot and rarely need random access.", what does "rule of thumb" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (cụm từ): quy tắc kinh nghiệm. "As a rule of thumb" = theo kinh nghiệm chung, không chính xác tuyệt đối nhưng hữu ích.
items.explanationEn: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (phrase): a practical guideline. "As a rule of thumb" introduces a practical guideline that is usually, not always, true.

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: pick a linked list when you add and remove at the front a lot and rarely need random access.", từ "random access" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule of thumb: pick a linked list when you add and remove at the front a lot and rarely need random access.", what does "random access" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: random access /ˌrændəm ˈækses/ (cụm từ): truy cập trực tiếp. "Random access" không có nghĩa là "ngẫu nhiên" mà là truy cập thẳng tới bất kỳ vị trí nào, như arr[i].
items.explanationEn: random access /ˌrændəm ˈækses/ (phrase): reaching any position directly. "Random access" does not mean "by chance"; it means jumping straight to any position, like arr[i].

items.question: Trong câu "It is also the building block for stacks and queues.", từ "building block" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is also the building block for stacks and queues.", what does "building block" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: building block /ˈbɪldɪŋ blɒk/ (cụm từ): thành phần nền tảng. "The building block for X" = thành phần cơ bản để xây dựng X.
items.explanationEn: building block /ˈbɪldɪŋ blɒk/ (phrase): a basic component. "The building block for X" is a basic part used to build X.

items.question: Trong câu "The while (current) loop is the traversal pattern every other method reuses: start at head, do something, move to current.next, stop at null.", từ "traversal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The while (current) loop is the traversal pattern every other method reuses: start at head, do something, move to current.next, stop at null.", what does "traversal" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: traversal /trəˈvɜːsl/ (danh từ): sự duyệt qua. Động từ là traverse; "tree traversal", "list traversal" = duyệt qua cây, duyệt qua danh sách.
items.explanationEn: traversal /trəˈvɜːsl/ (noun): visiting each item in turn. The verb is traverse; "tree traversal" and "list traversal" mean visiting every node.

items.question: Trong câu "Two invariants must hold after every method:", từ "invariant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two invariants must hold after every method:", what does "invariant" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a condition that always stays true
items.explanation: invariant /ɪnˈveəriənt/ (danh từ): điều kiện bất biến. "An invariant holds" = điều kiện bất biến luôn đúng; rất hay dùng khi chứng minh thuật toán đúng.
items.explanationEn: invariant /ɪnˈveəriənt/ (noun): a condition that always stays true. "An invariant holds" means the condition stays true; it is key when reasoning about correctness.

items.question: Trong câu "Most linked list bugs are an edge case (empty list, single node) that breaks one of these.", từ "edge case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most linked list bugs are an edge case (empty list, single node) that breaks one of these.", what does "edge case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: edge case /ˈedʒ keɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp biên. "Handle edge cases" = xử lý các trường hợp biên như danh sách rỗng hay chỉ có một phần tử.
items.explanationEn: edge case /ˈedʒ keɪs/ (phrase): an unusual boundary situation. "Handle edge cases" means dealing with boundary inputs such as an empty or one-item list.

items.question: Trong câu "If the list is empty, the node becomes both head and tail.", từ "empty" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the list is empty, the node becomes both head and tail.", what does "empty" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: empty /ˈempti/ (tính từ): trống, rỗng. "An empty list" = danh sách rỗng; luôn là edge case cần kiểm tra đầu tiên.
items.explanationEn: empty /ˈempti/ (adjective): containing nothing. "An empty list" has no items; it is the first edge case to check.

items.question: Trong câu "Otherwise link the current tail to it and move tail.", từ "otherwise" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Otherwise link the current tail to it and move tail.", what does "otherwise" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: if not; in the other case
items.explanation: otherwise /ˈʌðəwaɪz/ (trạng từ): nếu không thì. "Otherwise" = nếu điều kiện trước đó không đúng, tương đương nhánh else trong code.
items.explanationEn: otherwise /ˈʌðəwaɪz/ (adverb): if not; in the other case. "Otherwise" means if the previous condition is false, like the else branch in code.

items.question: Trong câu "Increment length and return the list.", từ "increment" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Increment length and return the list.", what does "increment" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: increment /ˈɪŋkrəment/ (động từ): tăng thêm (một đơn vị). "Increment a counter" = tăng bộ đếm; toán tử ++ trong JavaScript.
items.explanationEn: increment /ˈɪŋkrəment/ (verb): to increase by a step. "Increment a counter" means add one to it; in JavaScript it is the ++ operator.

items.question: Trong câu "O(1) time, O(1) space — thanks to the tail pointer.", từ "thanks to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "O(1) time, O(1) space — thanks to the tail pointer.", what does "thanks to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: thanks to /ˈθæŋks tə/ (cụm từ): nhờ có. "Thanks to X" = nhờ có X (chỉ nguyên nhân tích cực), không phải lời cảm ơn trực tiếp.
items.explanationEn: thanks to /ˈθæŋks tə/ (phrase): because of, owing to. "Thanks to X" means because of X (a positive cause), not a direct expression of gratitude.

items.question: Trong câu "Removing the tail is harder: we must make the second-to-last node the new tail, and a singly linked node has no pointer back to it.", từ "second-to-last" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Removing the tail is harder: we must make the second-to-last node the new tail, and a singly linked node has no pointer back to it.", what does "second-to-last" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: second-to-last /ˌsekənd tə ˈlɑːst/ (tính từ): áp chót, kế cuối. "Second-to-last" = đứng ngay trước phần tử cuối; từ đồng nghĩa là penultimate.
items.explanationEn: second-to-last /ˌsekənd tə ˈlɑːst/ (adjective): just before the last one. "Second-to-last" means right before the last item; a synonym is penultimate.

items.question: Trong câu "Removing the tail is harder: we must make the second-to-last node the new tail, and a singly linked node has no pointer back to it.", từ "remove" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Removing the tail is harder: we must make the second-to-last node the new tail, and a singly linked node has no pointer back to it.", what does "remove" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: remove /rɪˈmuːv/ (động từ): gỡ bỏ, lấy ra. "Remove X from Y" = lấy X ra khỏi Y; danh từ là removal.
items.explanationEn: remove /rɪˈmuːv/ (verb): to take away. "Remove X from Y" means take X out of Y; the noun is removal.

items.question: Trong câu "The length === 0 block matters: popping the only node leaves newTail pointing at the removed node, so head and tail must be cleared explicitly.", từ "explicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The length === 0 block matters: popping the only node leaves newTail pointing at the removed node, so head and tail must be cleared explicitly.", what does "explicitly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪsɪtli/ (trạng từ): một cách tường minh. "Explicitly" (tường minh) trái nghĩa với "implicitly" (ngầm định); code phải tự gán null, không tự xảy ra.
items.explanationEn: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪsɪtli/ (adverb): clearly and directly. "Explicitly" is the opposite of "implicitly"; the code must set the values itself.

items.question: Trong câu "shift removes the head: store it, move head to head.next, decrement.", từ "decrement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "shift removes the head: store it, move head to head.next, decrement.", what does "decrement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: decrement /ˈdekrɪment/ (động từ): giảm đi (một đơn vị). "Decrement" là ngược của increment; toán tử -- trong JavaScript.
items.explanationEn: decrement /ˈdekrɪment/ (verb): to decrease by a step. "Decrement" is the opposite of increment; in JavaScript it is the -- operator.

items.question: Trong câu "shift removes the head: store it, move head to head.next, decrement.", từ "store" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "shift removes the head: store it, move head to head.next, decrement.", what does "store" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: store /stɔː(r)/ (động từ): lưu giữ. "Store a value in a variable" = lưu giá trị vào biến; danh từ "store" còn nghĩa là cửa hàng.
items.explanationEn: store /stɔː(r)/ (verb): to keep for later use. "Store a value in a variable" means keep it for later; the noun "store" also means a shop.

items.question: Trong câu "Both are O(1) time, O(1) space — no matter how long the list is.", từ "no matter how" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both are O(1) time, O(1) space — no matter how long the list is.", what does "no matter how" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: no matter how /nəʊ ˈmætə haʊ/ (cụm từ): bất kể như thế nào. "No matter how + adj" = bất kể ... đến mức nào; ở đây: dù danh sách dài bao nhiêu.
items.explanationEn: no matter how /nəʊ ˈmætə haʊ/ (phrase): regardless of how. "No matter how + adjective" means regardless of the degree; here, however long the list is.

items.question: Trong câu "Compare Array.prototype.shift/unshift, which are O(n) because every element must be re-indexed.", từ "re-index" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Compare Array.prototype.shift/unshift, which are O(n) because every element must be re-indexed.", what does "re-index" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: re-index /ˌriː ˈɪndeks/ (động từ): đánh lại chỉ số. Tiền tố re- = làm lại; "re-index" = đánh lại số thứ tự cho mọi phần tử.
items.explanationEn: re-index /ˌriː ˈɪndeks/ (verb): to assign new index numbers. The prefix re- means again; "re-index" means giving every element a new position number.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the linked list's signature advantage.", từ "signature" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the linked list's signature advantage.", what does "signature" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: signature /ˈsɪɡnətʃə(r)/ (tính từ): đặc trưng, tiêu biểu. "Signature dish/advantage" = món/ưu điểm đặc trưng nhất; trong code "function signature" lại là chữ ký hàm.
items.explanationEn: signature /ˈsɪɡnətʃə(r)/ (adjective): most typical and distinctive. "Signature dish/advantage" is the most distinctive one; in code a "function signature" is something else.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the linked list's signature advantage.", từ "advantage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the linked list's signature advantage.", what does "advantage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: advantage /ədˈvɑːntɪdʒ/ (danh từ): ưu điểm, lợi thế. Trái nghĩa là disadvantage; "take advantage of X" = tận dụng X.
items.explanationEn: advantage /ədˈvɑːntɪdʒ/ (noun): a benefit, a strength. The opposite is disadvantage; "take advantage of X" means make use of X.

items.question: Trong câu "Unlike insert, index === length is out of range here: there is no node to remove.", từ "out of range" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Unlike insert, index === length is out of range here: there is no node to remove.", what does "out of range" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: out of range /ˌaʊt əv ˈreɪndʒ/ (cụm từ): nằm ngoài phạm vi. "Index out of range" = chỉ số nằm ngoài phạm vi hợp lệ; lỗi rất phổ biến.
items.explanationEn: out of range /ˌaʊt əv ˈreɪndʒ/ (phrase): outside the allowed limits. "Index out of range" means the index is outside the valid positions; a very common error.

items.question: Trong câu "set(index, val) reuses get and overwrites the value in place.", từ "overwrite" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "set(index, val) reuses get and overwrites the value in place.", what does "overwrite" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overwrite /ˌəʊvəˈraɪt/ (động từ): ghi đè lên. "Overwrite a value/file" = ghi dữ liệu mới đè lên dữ liệu cũ.
items.explanationEn: overwrite /ˌəʊvəˈraɪt/ (verb): to replace existing data. "Overwrite a value or file" means replace the old data with new data.

items.question: Trong câu "set(index, val) reuses get and overwrites the value in place.", từ "in place" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "set(index, val) reuses get and overwrites the value in place.", what does "in place" (phrase) mean?
options: tại chỗ, không tạo bản sao
items.explanation: in place /ɪn ˈpleɪs/ (cụm từ): tại chỗ, không tạo bản sao. "Modify in place" = sửa trực tiếp dữ liệu gốc; "in place of" lại nghĩa là thay cho.
items.explanationEn: in place /ɪn ˈpleɪs/ (phrase): without making a copy. "Modify in place" means change the original data; "in place of" means instead of.

items.question: Trong câu "Both are O(n) time in the worst case (O(index) exactly), O(1) space.", từ "worst case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both are O(n) time in the worst case (O(index) exactly), O(1) space.", what does "worst case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: worst case /ˌwɜːst ˈkeɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp xấu nhất. Big O thường mô tả "worst case"; ngoài ra còn best case và average case.
items.explanationEn: worst case /ˌwɜːst ˈkeɪs/ (phrase): the least favorable situation. Big O usually describes the worst case; the others are best case and average case.

items.question: Trong câu "Note get(0) is O(1) and get(length - 1) is O(n) even though we hold tail — the generic loop does not special-case it (you could add that shortcut).", từ "even though" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note get(0) is O(1) and get(length - 1) is O(n) even though we hold tail — the generic loop does not special-case it (you could add that shortcut).", what does "even though" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: even though /ˌiːvn ˈðəʊ/ (liên từ): mặc dù. "Even though" nhấn mạnh sự trái ngược mạnh hơn "although".
items.explanationEn: even though /ˌiːvn ˈðəʊ/ (conjunction): despite the fact that. "Even though" stresses a contrast more strongly than "although".

items.question: Trong câu "Note get(0) is O(1) and get(length - 1) is O(n) even though we hold tail — the generic loop does not special-case it (you could add that shortcut).", từ "generic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note get(0) is O(1) and get(length - 1) is O(n) even though we hold tail — the generic loop does not special-case it (you could add that shortcut).", what does "generic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: generic /dʒəˈnerɪk/ (tính từ): chung, tổng quát. "A generic solution" = giải pháp dùng chung cho mọi trường hợp; "generic drugs" = thuốc không thương hiệu.
items.explanationEn: generic /dʒəˈnerɪk/ (adjective): general, not specialised. "A generic solution" works for all cases; "generic drugs" are medicines without a brand name.

items.question: Trong câu "Note get(0) is O(1) and get(length - 1) is O(n) even though we hold tail — the generic loop does not special-case it (you could add that shortcut).", từ "shortcut" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note get(0) is O(1) and get(length - 1) is O(n) even though we hold tail — the generic loop does not special-case it (you could add that shortcut).", what does "shortcut" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a quicker way to do something
items.explanation: shortcut /ˈʃɔːtkʌt/ (danh từ): lối tắt. "Take a shortcut" = đi lối tắt; "keyboard shortcut" là phím tắt, một nghĩa khác.
items.explanationEn: shortcut /ˈʃɔːtkʌt/ (noun): a quicker way to do something. "Take a shortcut" means use a quicker route; a "keyboard shortcut" is a different sense.

items.question: Trong câu "To insert at index we need the node before that position, so we can rewire around it.", từ "rewire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: rewire /ˌriːˈwaɪə(r)/ (động từ): nối lại (con trỏ). Nghĩa gốc là đi lại dây điện; trong linked list là đổi các con trỏ next.
items.explanationEn: rewire /ˌriːˈwaɪə(r)/ (verb): to reconnect the links. Literally it means replacing wires; in linked lists it means changing the next pointers.

items.question: Trong câu "Note index === this.length is valid for insert (append), which is why the guard uses >.", từ "valid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note index === this.length is valid for insert (append), which is why the guard uses >.", what does "valid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: valid /ˈvælɪd/ (tính từ): hợp lệ. Trái nghĩa là invalid; "validate input" = kiểm tra dữ liệu có hợp lệ không.
items.explanationEn: valid /ˈvælɪd/ (adjective): acceptable by the rules. The opposite is invalid; "validate input" means check that it is acceptable.

items.question: Trong câu "Note index === this.length is valid for insert (append), which is why the guard uses >.", từ "append" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note index === this.length is valid for insert (append), which is why the guard uses >.", what does "append" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: append /əˈpend/ (động từ): nối thêm vào cuối. "Append X to Y" = thêm X vào cuối Y; ngược với prepend.
items.explanationEn: append /əˈpend/ (verb): to add at the end. "Append X to Y" means add X at the end of Y; the opposite is prepend.

items.question: Trong câu "Note index === this.length is valid for insert (append), which is why the guard uses >.", từ "guard" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note index === this.length is valid for insert (append), which is why the guard uses >.", what does "guard" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a check that stops bad input
items.explanation: guard /ɡɑːd/ (danh từ): điều kiện chặn (kiểm tra). "Guard clause" = câu lệnh kiểm tra ở đầu hàm để return sớm; nghĩa đời thường là người bảo vệ.
items.explanationEn: guard /ɡɑːd/ (noun): a check that stops bad input. A "guard clause" is an early check that returns from a function; in daily life a guard is a security officer.

items.question: Trong câu "Unlike insert, index === length is out of range here: there is no node to remove.", từ "unlike" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Unlike insert, index === length is out of range here: there is no node to remove.", what does "unlike" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: unlike /ʌnˈlaɪk/ (giới từ): khác với. "Unlike X, Y ..." = khác với X thì Y...; dùng để so sánh đối lập.
items.explanationEn: unlike /ʌnˈlaɪk/ (preposition): different from. "Unlike X, Y ..." introduces a contrast between two things.

items.question: Trong câu "Removing index 0 is O(1); removing the last index delegates to pop, which is still O(n).", từ "delegate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

optionsEn: to hand the work to another
items.explanation: delegate /ˈdelɪɡeɪt/ (động từ): giao lại (cho hàm khác). "Delegate to X" = chuyển việc cho X làm; danh từ "delegate" là đại biểu.
items.explanationEn: delegate /ˈdelɪɡeɪt/ (verb): to hand the work to another. "Delegate to X" means pass the work to X; the noun "delegate" means a representative.

items.question: Trong câu "Reverse the list without creating new nodes: flip every next pointer to point backwards.", từ "reverse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reverse the list without creating new nodes: flip every next pointer to point backwards.", what does "reverse" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to turn into the opposite order
items.explanation: reverse /rɪˈvɜːs/ (động từ): đảo ngược thứ tự. "Reverse a list/string" = đảo ngược thứ tự; "reverse a decision" = huỷ quyết định.
items.explanationEn: reverse /rɪˈvɜːs/ (verb): to turn into the opposite order. "Reverse a list or string" means put it in opposite order; "reverse a decision" means cancel it.

items.question: Trong câu "Reverse the list without creating new nodes: flip every next pointer to point backwards.", từ "flip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reverse the list without creating new nodes: flip every next pointer to point backwards.", what does "flip" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to turn over the other way
items.explanation: flip /flɪp/ (động từ): lật ngược. "Flip a pointer/bit" = đảo hướng con trỏ hoặc đảo bit 0↔1.
items.explanationEn: flip /flɪp/ (verb): to turn over the other way. "Flip a pointer or bit" means turn it to the opposite direction or value.

items.question: Trong câu "Reverse the list without creating new nodes: flip every next pointer to point backwards.", từ "backwards" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reverse the list without creating new nodes: flip every next pointer to point backwards.", what does "backwards" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: backwards /ˈbækwədz/ (trạng từ): về phía sau. "Walk backwards" = đi lùi; trái nghĩa là forwards.
items.explanationEn: backwards /ˈbækwədz/ (adverb): toward the rear. "Walk backwards" means move toward the rear; the opposite is forwards.

items.question: Trong câu "Three variables walk together: prev, node, next.", từ "variable" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three variables walk together: prev, node, next.", what does "variable" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: variable /ˈveəriəbl/ (danh từ): biến (trong code). "Declare a variable" = khai báo biến; trong khoa học "variable" là yếu tố thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: variable /ˈveəriəbl/ (noun): a named value in code. "Declare a variable" means create one in code; in science a variable is a changing factor.

items.question: Trong câu "A recursive reverse is also O(n) time but uses O(n) space on the call stack.", từ "recursive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A recursive reverse is also O(n) time but uses O(n) space on the call stack.", what does "recursive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: recursive /rɪˈkɜːsɪv/ (tính từ): đệ quy. "A recursive function" = hàm tự gọi lại chính nó; danh từ là recursion.
items.explanationEn: recursive /rɪˈkɜːsɪv/ (adjective): calling itself. "A recursive function" calls itself; the noun is recursion.

items.question: Trong câu "A recursive reverse is also O(n) time but uses O(n) space on the call stack.", từ "call stack" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A recursive reverse is also O(n) time but uses O(n) space on the call stack.", what does "call stack" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: call stack /ˈkɔːl stæk/ (cụm từ): ngăn xếp lời gọi hàm. Mỗi lần gọi đệ quy thêm một frame vào call stack; quá sâu sẽ gây stack overflow.
items.explanationEn: call stack /ˈkɔːl stæk/ (phrase): memory tracking active function calls. Each recursive call adds a frame to the call stack; too many cause a stack overflow.

items.question: Trong câu "Reversing a linked list is one of the most common interview warm-ups — know the four lines by heart.", từ "common" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: common /ˈkɒmən/ (adjective): happening often. "One of the most common X" means among the most frequent; "in common" means shared.

items.question: Trong câu "Reversing a linked list is one of the most common interview warm-ups — know the four lines by heart.", từ "warm-up" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reversing a linked list is one of the most common interview warm-ups — know the four lines by heart.", what does "warm-up" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: warm-up /ˈwɔːm ʌp/ (danh từ): bài khởi động. "A warm-up question" = câu hỏi khởi động dễ ở đầu buổi phỏng vấn.
items.explanationEn: warm-up /ˈwɔːm ʌp/ (noun): an easy opening exercise. "A warm-up question" is an easy one at the start of an interview.

items.question: Trong câu "Reversing a linked list is one of the most common interview warm-ups — know the four lines by heart.", từ "by heart" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reversing a linked list is one of the most common interview warm-ups — know the four lines by heart.", what does "by heart" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by heart /baɪ ˈhɑːt/ (cụm từ): thuộc lòng. "Know/learn something by heart" = thuộc lòng, nhớ không cần nhìn.
items.explanationEn: by heart /baɪ ˈhɑːt/ (phrase): from memory. "Know or learn something by heart" means remember it completely.

items.question: Trong câu "The storage of the list itself is O(n).", từ "storage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: storage /ˈstɔːrɪdʒ/ (noun): space used to hold data. "Storage" here is the memory needed to hold the list; in daily life it is a place to keep things.

items.question: Trong câu "The usual shorthand is "insertion O(1), removal O(1) or O(n), search O(n), access O(n)": insertion at either end is O(1); removal is O(1) at the head but O(n) at the tail.", từ "shorthand" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The usual shorthand is "insertion O(1), removal O(1) or O(n), search O(n), access O(n)": insertion at either end is O(1); removal is O(1) at the head but O(n) at the tail.", what does "shorthand" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a short way of saying something
items.explanation: shorthand /ˈʃɔːthænd/ (danh từ): cách viết tóm gọn. "Shorthand for X" = cách nói ngắn gọn cho X; nghĩa gốc là chữ tốc ký.
items.explanationEn: shorthand /ˈʃɔːthænd/ (noun): a short way of saying something. "Shorthand for X" is a brief way to express X; originally it means a fast writing system.

items.question: Trong câu "Because push + shift are both O(1), a singly linked list gives an efficient queue (enqueue at tail, dequeue at head), and unshift + shift give a stack at the head.", từ "efficient" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because push + shift are both O(1), a singly linked list gives an efficient queue (enqueue at tail, dequeue at head), and unshift + shift give a stack at the head.", what does "efficient" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: efficient /ɪˈfɪʃnt/ (tính từ): hiệu quả (ít tốn tài nguyên). "Efficient" nhấn mạnh ít tốn thời gian/bộ nhớ; "effective" là đạt được kết quả.
items.explanationEn: efficient /ɪˈfɪʃnt/ (adjective): using few resources. "Efficient" stresses using little time or memory; "effective" means producing the result.

items.question: Trong câu "Because push + shift are both O(1), a singly linked list gives an efficient queue (enqueue at tail, dequeue at head), and unshift + shift give a stack at the head.", từ "queue" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: queue /kjuː/ (noun): a first-in, first-out structure. A queue is FIFO; in British English a queue is also a line of people.

items.question: Trong câu "Placing a fake node before the real head removes the "is this index 0?" special case, because every real node then has a predecessor:", từ "fake" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: fake /feɪk/ (tính từ): giả, không thật. "A fake/dummy node" = nút giả chỉ để đơn giản hoá code; trái nghĩa là real.
items.explanationEn: fake /feɪk/ (adjective): not real, dummy. "A fake or dummy node" exists only to simplify code; the opposite is real.

items.question: Trong câu "Placing a fake node before the real head removes the "is this index 0?" special case, because every real node then has a predecessor:", từ "predecessor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: predecessor /ˈpriːdɪsesə(r)/ (danh từ): phần tử đứng trước. Predecessor là ngược của successor; với người nó nghĩa là người tiền nhiệm.
items.explanationEn: predecessor /ˈpriːdɪsesə(r)/ (noun): the item that comes before. Predecessor is the opposite of successor; for people it means someone who held a job before.

items.question: Trong câu "Move slow one step and fast two steps per iteration.", từ "iteration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Move slow one step and fast two steps per iteration.", what does "iteration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: iteration /ˌɪtəˈreɪʃn/ (danh từ): một vòng lặp. "Per iteration" = mỗi vòng lặp; động từ là iterate. Trong sản phẩm, iteration còn là một phiên bản.
items.explanationEn: iteration /ˌɪtəˈreɪʃn/ (noun): one pass through a loop. "Per iteration" means each time through the loop; the verb is iterate. For products it can mean a version.

items.question: Trong câu "When fast reaches the end, slow is at the middle — one pass, O(1) space.", từ "pass" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When fast reaches the end, slow is at the middle — one pass, O(1) space.", what does "pass" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a ball thrown to a teammate
items.explanation: pass /pɑːs/ (danh từ): một lượt duyệt. "In one pass / a single pass" = chỉ duyệt dữ liệu một lần.
items.explanationEn: pass /pɑːs/ (noun): one run through the data. "In one pass" or "a single pass" means going through the data only once.

items.question: Trong câu "When fast reaches the end, slow is at the middle — one pass, O(1) space.", từ "reach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: reach /riːtʃ/ (động từ): đi tới, chạm tới. "Reach the end" = đi tới cuối; "reach out to someone" = liên hệ ai đó.
items.explanationEn: reach /riːtʃ/ (verb): to arrive at. "Reach the end" means arrive at it; "reach out to someone" means contact them.

items.question: Trong câu "The same idea (Floyd's algorithm) detects a cycle: if fast ever meets slow, the list loops.", từ "detect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: detect /dɪˈtekt/ (động từ): phát hiện. "Detect a cycle/error" = phát hiện chu trình/lỗi; danh từ là detection.
items.explanationEn: detect /dɪˈtekt/ (verb): to discover or notice. "Detect a cycle or error" means discover it; the noun is detection.

items.question: Trong câu "The same idea (Floyd's algorithm) detects a cycle: if fast ever meets slow, the list loops.", từ "cycle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same idea (Floyd's algorithm) detects a cycle: if fast ever meets slow, the list loops.", what does "cycle" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: cycle /ˈsaɪkl/ (danh từ): chu trình (vòng khép kín). "A cycle in a linked list" = một nút trỏ ngược về nút trước, tạo vòng lặp vô tận.
items.explanationEn: cycle /ˈsaɪkl/ (noun): a closed loop of links. "A cycle in a linked list" means a node points back to an earlier node, forming an endless loop.

items.question: Trong câu "The same idea (Floyd's algorithm) detects a cycle: if fast ever meets slow, the list loops.", từ "loop" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same idea (Floyd's algorithm) detects a cycle: if fast ever meets slow, the list loops.", what does "loop" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: loop /luːp/ (động từ): tạo thành vòng lặp. Động từ "loop" = quay vòng lại; "loop through an array" = lặp qua mảng.
items.explanationEn: loop /luːp/ (verb): to form a circle back. The verb "loop" means go round in a circle; "loop through an array" means iterate over it.

items.question: Trong câu "Other classic bugs: not clearing head/tail when the list becomes empty (a second pop then "removes" the same node again and length goes to -1), forgetting length++/--, and rewiring pointers in the wrong order (losing the rest of the list).", từ "classic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Other classic bugs: not clearing head/tail when the list becomes empty (a second pop then "removes" the same node again and length goes to -1), forgetting length++/--, and rewiring pointers in the wrong order (losing the rest of the list).", what does "classic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: classic /ˈklæsɪk/ (tính từ): điển hình, kinh điển. "A classic mistake" = lỗi điển hình ai cũng từng mắc; "classical music" là nhạc cổ điển.
items.explanationEn: classic /ˈklæsɪk/ (adjective): typical and well known. "A classic mistake" is a typical, well-known one; "classical music" is a different word.

items.question: Trong câu "Arrays win on indexing and cache locality.", từ "locality" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Arrays win on indexing and cache locality.", what does "locality" (noun) mean?
options: tính cục bộ (dữ liệu gần nhau)
items.explanation: locality /ləʊˈkæləti/ (danh từ): tính cục bộ (dữ liệu gần nhau). "Cache locality" = dữ liệu nằm gần nhau nên CPU cache đọc nhanh; nghĩa thường là một vùng địa phương.
items.explanationEn: locality /ləʊˈkæləti/ (noun): keeping related data close together. "Cache locality" means data sits close together so the CPU cache reads it fast; generally it means a district.

items.question: Trong câu "Guards differ: insert allows index === length, remove/get/set do not.", từ "differ" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Guards differ: insert allows index === length, remove/get/set do not.", what does "differ" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪfə(r)/ (động từ): khác nhau. "X and Y differ in Z" = X và Y khác nhau ở Z; đừng nhầm với defer (trì hoãn).
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪfə(r)/ (verb): to be unlike each other. "X and Y differ in Z" means they are unlike in Z; do not confuse it with defer (postpone).

items.question: Trong câu "Always handle the empty and single-node cases and keep head/tail/length consistent.", từ "handle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Always handle the empty and single-node cases and keep head/tail/length consistent.", what does "handle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: handle /ˈhændl/ (động từ): xử lý. "Handle an error/case" = xử lý lỗi/trường hợp; danh từ "handle" còn là tay cầm.
items.explanationEn: handle /ˈhændl/ (verb): to deal with. "Handle an error or case" means deal with it; the noun "handle" is the part you hold.

items.question: Trong câu "Always handle the empty and single-node cases and keep head/tail/length consistent.", từ "consistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Always handle the empty and single-node cases and keep head/tail/length consistent.", what does "consistent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: consistent /kənˈsɪstənt/ (tính từ): nhất quán, khớp nhau. "Keep X consistent" = giữ X luôn khớp nhau; "consistent performance" = hiệu suất ổn định.
items.explanationEn: consistent /kənˈsɪstənt/ (adjective): in agreement with each other. "Keep X consistent" means keep the parts in agreement; "consistent performance" means steady performance.

items.question: Trong câu "Linked lists trade O(1) indexed access for O(1) insertion and removal at the front.", từ "trade" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linked lists trade O(1) indexed access for O(1) insertion and removal at the front.", what does "trade" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give up one thing for another
items.explanation: trade /treɪd/ (động từ): đánh đổi. "Trade X for Y" = đánh đổi X lấy Y; danh từ "trade-off" là sự đánh đổi.
items.explanationEn: trade /treɪd/ (verb): to give up one thing for another. "Trade X for Y" means give up X to get Y; the noun "trade-off" is such a compromise.

items.question: Trong câu "Linked lists are the foundation for stacks, queues and doubly linked lists.", từ "foundation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linked lists are the foundation for stacks, queues and doubly linked lists.", what does "foundation" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the base something is built on
items.explanation: foundation /faʊnˈdeɪʃn/ (danh từ): nền tảng, cơ sở. "The foundation for X" = nền tảng để xây dựng X; "a foundation" còn là quỹ từ thiện.
items.explanationEn: foundation /faʊnˈdeɪʃn/ (noun): the base something is built on. "The foundation for X" is the base X is built on; "a foundation" can also be a charity.
